title: Chickpea Salad with Creamy Smoky Tahini Dressing!
byline: Sam Turnbull @ It Doesn't Taste Like Chicken
ldName: Chickpea Salad with Creamy Smoky Tahini Dressing
ldYield: 6 (6-8 as a side, or 4 as a main)
ldIngredientsRaw: 2 tablespoons olive oil ((sub water for oil-free))
2 cans (14oz each) chickpeas (drained and rinsed (3 cups))
1/4 cup fresh dill (finely chopped (or sub parsley or cilantro))
1/4 cup roasted salted pepitas ((or sub pistachios, sunflower seeds, or slivered almonds))
ldInstructionsRaw: Make the dressing: In a small bowl or jar, whisk together the tahini, olive oil, lime juice, smoked paprika, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, garlic powder, and black pepper. Add water 1 tablespoon at a time, whisking until the dressing is creamy and pourable.

Assemble the salad: In a large mixing bowl, combine the chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes, red onion, and dill. Pour about half of the dressing over the salad and toss to coat. Taste and add more dressing as desired, you may not need it all. Sprinkle the pepitas on top just before serving.

Storage: Store leftovers in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 4 days. If prepping ahead, keep the pepitas separate and add just before serving so they stay crunchy. The flavor gets even better as it sits!
